resources.string: VoiceDock AI — insert text & explain screen

VoiceDock acts only when you ask. Insert: it types your approved draft into the text field that has the cursor (never password fields). Explain screen: it takes ONE screenshot plus the visible text and sends them to the AI provider you set up. Agent task (only after you start one): it reads the screen, and taps, scrolls, types and opens apps step by step to do that task; every step is shown in the bubble, sending/deleting/paying/calling needs your Allow, finance apps are blocked, and the Stop button ends it at once. Since v0.6, tapping the floating assistant bubble performs ONE on-tap read of visible text so it can offer contextual help; this needs a separate consent switch and never runs in the background. Password/OTP/card/finance screens are refused. It never watches the screen continuously, does not record what you type and stores nothing from the probe. You can turn it off at any time.
